title: Invert Binary Tree

contractDetails.constraints: 0–100 nodes. Node values are integers from −100 to 100. Duplicate values are allowed.

statement: Mirror a binary tree. For every node, the subtree on its original left belongs on the right in the result, and the subtree on its original right belongs on the left. Return the root of the mirrored tree, or null for an empty tree. The result is judged by values and shape.

examples.explanation: The 4 moves from the old left child's right side to its new left side.
The mirror of an empty tree is empty.
The only child moves from right to left.

constraints: 0–100 nodes. Node values are integers from −100 to 100. Duplicate values are allowed.
hints: Conceptual: A mirror changes which side each child is on, even when there is only one child.
Directional: Visit each node and exchange its two child links.
Implementation: Save the old child pointers before assigning either one. Visit each non-null child exactly once.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time. A depth-first traversal uses O(h) auxiliary space for tree height h.
